finding.passing_witness_started_after_terminal: The hermetic detached-supervisor.selftest waited for the supervisor to reach STOPPED_EXHAUSTED BEFORE spawning the witness, so HEALTHY_CONTINUE was proven only POST-TERMINAL, not while RUN_ACTIVE.
finding.active_attempt_returned_INSUFFICIENT_EVI: An earlier active-run attempt returned INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and was masked by the reorder.
finding.evidence_files_wrong_path: witness-main.mjs buildSnapshot read evidence from join(runRoot,"ev"), but authoritative evidence is written per job under the manifest evidence_root and indexed via evidence_index_path (real-seams.mjs:44, harness.mjs:259).
finding.instantaneous_provider_signal: provider_invocations was derived from an instantaneous pgrep child snapshot at the last poll; a legitimate between-job / machine-verify interval has zero provider children.
finding.terminal_confused_with_continue: health-witness accepted terminal fail-closed state as satisfying provider/evidence checks and mapped generic HEALTHY -> HEALTHY_CONTINUE without requiring RUN_ACTIVE at window end, so a completed run received HEALTHY_CONTINUE.
finding.fixture_too_short: The 2-job deterministic fixture terminated in seconds and could not sustain an observable active window.

prior_reviews.seam_closure_and_detached_process_proof: REMAIN VALID (not rebuilt): both seam refusals, immutable 720000 witness constant, test-support isolation, single production route, launcher-exits/distinct-PID/supervisor-survival/teardown/replay.

correction_summary.witness_evidence_path: read the AUTHORITATIVE evidence_index_path (per-run, manifest-bound) line growth; no hard-coded runRoot/ev.
correction_summary.cumulative_provider_progress: progress derived from durable/cumulative signals across the observation window (evidence-index growth OR provider-child-present at any poll OR heartbeat advance), never a single final-snapshot child PID.
correction_summary.verdict_semantics: HEALTHY_CONTINUE ONLY when RUN_ACTIVE + alive + progress (or bounded grace) at window end; a successful terminal run returns COMPLETED_HEALTHY (never HEALTHY_CONTINUE); stall -> HELD; boundary/identity/lineage/deadline breach -> FAILED; unreadable -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
correction_summary.no_new_authority_file: reuses supervisor state + the authoritative evidence index; introduces no second evidence/queue/budget authority.
correction_summary.active_fixture: a longer deterministic-stub run stays genuinely RUN_ACTIVE past the accelerated witness window so the witness observes an ACTIVE run and the same supervisor/run continue afterward.
